question: What prior analyses support the account of Maya's coverings and effects?
premises: The group of coverings born of Maya has been examined before.
The collection of instruments has been examined before.
The group of effects has also been discussed before.
inference: Therefore the present argument rests on previously established analyses of coverings, instruments, and effects.
plain_english: The group of coverings born of Maya, as well as the collection of instruments, has already been examined before, and the group of effects has also been discussed.
